nodes.text: China has dismissed claims of overcrowded hospitals due to Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV). Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning stated, "There's no reason for foreigners to worry." Symptoms are flu-like, and children and the elderly are most at risk. 🏥💬
